plans.idea: Classic left-to-right leaderboard: brand mark, then a big full-height headline, then the bottle as a product anchor with the tilted NEW VIDEO tag beside it, so the strip reads brand > message > product > hook.
Product-first: the bottle anchors the left edge like the original's hero, the headline fills the centre at full height, and the badge and logo close out the right as a sign-off cluster.
Brand-and-hook lead-in: logo and NEW VIDEO tag grouped tightly on the left as a kicker, the headline as the centrepiece, and the bottle set apart on the right with generous breathing room.
